How do I earn and redeem rewards on my Solitaire Credit Card?

Every transaction made with your Mashreq Solitaire Credit Card, international or local, you will earn Mashreq Vantage reward points. You can redeem them instantly via Mashreq Mobile App or at a partner merchant. To know more visit mashreq.com/vantage.
How do I get complimentary access to Fitness First? Also, is the benefit applicable for Supplementary Cardholders as well?
If the minimum spend requirement is not met, a fee of AED 50 will be applicable for every visit to Fitness First.
How many complimentary airport transfer services can I get?
How many complimentary lounge access visits can I receive in a year? Is there a spend criteria to get the benefit?
You can get 12 complimentary airport lounge visits in a calendar year subject to fulfillment of the below spend criteria:

1 international transaction >1 USD every calendar year; it may take up to 15 days for the information of meeting eligibility criteria to be visible on the Lounge Key system. If the card is replaced, then > 1 USD transaction is mandatory on the replaced card to become eligible for the lounge benefit within the calendar year
If you do not meet the above spend criteria, then you can receive 2 complimentary airport lounge visits in a calendar year (to be used twice by the Cardholder or once by the Cardholder and a Guest).
Visits are applicable for the Cardholder or the Cardholder and guest (up to one complimentary guest per visit).
How many complimentary valet services can I receive in a month? Which all locations are covered under this service?
Cancellations will be accepted only if done 4 days prior to the booked time of play. In the event of a no show, the booking will be counted under your complimentary number of rounds for the month.
What all spends will be eligible for the total purchase amount required to enjoy complimentary benefits like Fitness First and lounge access?

.All purchases on your Solitaire Credit Card, including Supplementary, will be eligible and counted against the minimum purchase amount required to avail the complimentary benefits. Bank Fee/Charges, Cash advances and Balance Transfer/Easy Cash transactions will not be counted under the minimum purchase amount.
Your monthly income should be a minimum of AED 25,000.
